Tools.GameLink.Agreement.Title: Multiplayer instructions and terms
Tools.GameLink.Agreement.Description: PCL.Proto uses the same multiplayer service as PCL-CE and follows the PCL-CE usage policies. Please read the information, privacy policy and terms below before using it.
Tools.GameLink.Agreement.Body:
By using the lobby feature, you agree to the following terms:

I agree to comply with applicable laws and regulations and will not use the lobby feature for illegal or prohibited purposes.
I agree to bear all risks associated with using the lobby feature.
I acknowledge and agree that PCL-CE collects processed device identifiers, Natayark ID, and other information, and may provide them to law enforcement when necessary.
To protect minors' personal information, I confirm that I am at least 14 years old before using the lobby.

Additionally, you must also agree to the PCL-CE lobby privacy policy and the Natayark OpenID terms of service.
Tools.GameLink.Agreement.PrivacyPolicyIn: Learn how PCL-CE handles your personal information.
